mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wf_process_def (id, process_key, process_name, version, category, bpmn_xml, applicable_orgs, form_schema_id, status, deployed_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{processKey}, #{processName}, #{version}, #{category}, #{bpmnXml}, #{applicableOrgs}, #{formSchemaId}, #{status}, #{deployedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM wf_process_def WHERE process_key = #{key} AND version = #{version}
SELECT * FROM wf_process_def WHERE 1=1 AND status = #{status} AND process_key LIKE CONCAT('%', #{processKey}, '%') ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE wf_process_def SET status = #{status}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}
